df30532ee6.rewrite:
cld
lods rax,QWORD PTR ds:[rsi]
not rax
stos QWORD PTR es:[rdi],rax
dec rdx
sub rdx,0xe
df30532ee6.why: Clearing DF lets LODS and STOS combine the qword transfers with their pointer increments. Retaining DEC followed by SUB preserves CF even when the initial rdx is zero.

42bada3b3b.rewrite:

movq rax,xmm1

42bada3b3b.why: A single unaligned SSE2 load and store copy the same sixteen bytes, while MOVQ preserves the required low qword in rax. The original TEST preserves ZF, and rcx is dead.

dfe8044e76.why: Three-operand IMUL by minus one replaces zeroing r10 and subtracting rax, producing the same negated shift count. The shifts retain their original behavior for every count, and the final TEST supplies the required ZF.
